notes.title: We're in Turn-Based RPG Fest 2024
notes.content:
Patrons of the Great Library,

We're happy to announce a new demo build for Scarlet Record! 

What's new:
[list]
[*]New and improved node exploration system--now it comes with narrative that grants boons or curses to your party.
[*]New enemies that can be found in certain area
[*]Added two additional difficulty setting: Story for those who wants to follow the story while having a bit of kick in combat; and Challenging for those seeking for challenges against various enemies throughout Ruby's journey
[*]Several visual updates as well as QoL features
[*]A few housekeepings
[/list]

As always, if you're interested in following Scarlet Record's development, feel free to follow [url=https://twitter.com/_CrescentSun]our X (FKA Twitter) account[/url]--we usually post our progress weekly. Or join our Discord server.


That's all from us for now.
Cheers!

notes.title: 0.5.2.4 Demo Update
notes.content:
Patrons of the Great Library,

Thank you for playing Scarlet Record!
An update for Scarlet Record demo has been implemented. The update covers:
[list]
[*]Fixes for several minor glitches including scanline functionality, status buildup and Cure Pill doesn't clear ailments in combat;
[*]Minor tweaks on current node maps--now boss encounter nodes will show a proper icon
[*]Minor tweaks on several characters, including Hazel's visual animation fix and a crash involving one of Verde's perks; and 
[*]A small revamp on several dialogue lines
[/list]

As always, if you're interested in following Scarlet Record's development, feel free to follow [url=https://twitter.com/_CrescentSun]our X (FKA Twitter) account[/url]--we usually post our progress weekly. Or join our Discord server.


That's all from us for now.
Cheers!
